title: round 3
lede: Burooj on round 2 (2026-11-02): the picks stand except Kasiṇa (B) and the Headless Way, which none of the three caught; it is redrawn here with the six round 1 figures flagged last round. Same rules: abstract, quiet, graceful, a slow ~10 s breath, something true about the practice, no human shapes, varied grounds. Each practice shows round 1's tile first (and the Headless Way's rejected round 2 variants), then two or three variants, on phone-sized tiles (170 dp) in Tidewater light and dark. The orange outline is the variant I'd ship; library: any marks an unpicked variant generic enough for the figure library, library: practice one too tied to its practice.
library: Unpicked variants join the art engine's figure library, to be drawn at random for user content (imports, playlists) as other figures are. `any`: generic enough for any item. `practice`: too tied to its practice to appear on an unrelated import; only for content about that practice. `none`: kept out of the library entirely (Burooj, 2026-11-03).
decided: Burooj, 2026-11-03: the picks stand except Forgiveness (B, mended with gold) and The Mind Illuminated (a combination of A and B: steadying upwards). Walking A and Forgiveness C are out of the library.

practices.name: Headless Way
practices.desc: Looking back at where your head should be, and finding open space.
practices.why: Round 2: face to no-face was too busy, pointing back didn't land. Quieter: here, no head — open capacity, full of the world.

practices.name: Caṅkama · Kinhin
practices.desc: Walking slowly and knowing each step: lifting, moving, placing.

practices.name: Forgiveness
practices.desc: Loosening resentment, towards others and towards yourself.
practices.why: The still was a near-straight scribble.

practices.name: The Mind Illuminated
practices.desc: Culadasa's ten stages, from a wandering mind to effortless attention.
practices.why: Ten small dots on an arc read as a loading spinner. Round 3: Burooj asked for A and B combined, steadying upwards; D and E are that combination, without A's triangle (it read as a Christmas tree).

practices.name: Anussati
practices.desc: Recollecting the Buddha, Dhamma and Saṅgha, virtue, generosity and peace.
practices.why: The diamonds read as card suits.

practices.name: Karuṇā
practices.desc: Letting suffering in and meeting it with care; in tonglen, breathing it in and sending ease out.
practices.why: The still read as an eye.

practices.name: Jhāna
practices.desc: The meditative absorptions: joy and ease gathering into deep stillness.
practices.why: The still read as a sun icon.
